up: Show the first 200 metabolism records involving CYP3A4 or CYP3A5. Include the substrate compound name, parent compound name, canonical SMILES, metabolic conversion (met_conversion), pathway key (pathway_key), and organism. Use the metabolism table enzyme name to filter for 'CYP3A4' or 'CYP3A5'. Join compound_structures on the parent compound record to retrieve the SMILES.
sql:
SELECT DISTINCT
  met.met_conversion,
  met.pathway_key,
  met.organism,
  parent_cr.compound_name AS parent_compound_name,
  substr_cr.compound_name AS substrate_compound_name,
  cs.canonical_smiles
FROM metabolism met
JOIN compound_records parent_cr ON met.drug_record_id = parent_cr.record_id
JOIN compound_records substr_cr ON met.substrate_record_id = substr_cr.record_id
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON parent_cr.molregno = md.molregno
LEFT JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno
WHERE met.enzyme_name IN ('CYP3A4', 'CYP3A5')
LIMIT 200;
